items.headline: Google’s AI feature in Search gets its own incognito mode
items.excerpt: Google's new temporary threads let users have conversations in AI Mode without adding them to their search history or influencing future recommendations.

items.headline: More banks say customers using AI agents are on their own — even if they get hacked
items.excerpt: Citi is the latest major financial institution to put the breaks on personal finance AI agents.

items.headline: Sam Altman warns against a future where AI, not humans, calls the shots
items.excerpt: Sam Altman and Greg Brockman pushed back against Silicon Valley's growing debate over an AI takeover, while acknowledging the challenges of keeping advanced models under human control.

items.headline: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says it’s ‘hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen’
items.excerpt: Nvidia founder and former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down last week amid several scandals, including an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

items.headline: Nvidia clarifies when it will — and won’t — keep financing neoclouds
items.excerpt: If Nvidia is backstopping a data center loan, it won't be on the hook unless the neocould has independent financing and gets the facility built, with Nvidia gear installed, interim CEO Colette Kress explained.

items.headline: Felicis leads $7.5M bet on Unsiloed AI to make enterprise documents usable by AI agents
items.excerpt: With a team of just seven, Unsiloed AI plans to compete with tech giants and specialized startups in the crowded AI document-processing market.

items.headline: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed US robotics companies the data they need
items.excerpt: Founded in February, Humyn Labs competes with startups such as Mecka AI and XDOF, with about 90% of its revenue coming from the U.S.

items.headline: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future  deals in doubt
items.excerpt: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.

items.headline: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
items.excerpt: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.

items.headline: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang’s ouster
items.excerpt: Nvidia's interim CEO says the company is done selling chips to China. How much will that cost?

items.headline: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit
items.excerpt: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.

items.headline: Nvidia says it doesn’t plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO
items.excerpt: The former CEO offered to return to his top role at the company after his resignation last week.

items.headline: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
items.excerpt: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.

items.headline: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
items.excerpt: The SEC is opening a probe into Nvidia following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, reports The Wall Street Journal.

items.headline: Google joins the tech outage trend by announcing it’s not having one
items.excerpt: With tech outages seemingly everywhere, Google took the unusual step of announcing that Gmail is working just fine, actually.

items.headline: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
items.excerpt: The startup says its agents understand the full context of deals that bankers and consultants are working on and can automatically update financial models and presentations when new developments affect their analysis.

items.headline: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
items.excerpt: Gemini's Task mode can help users coordinate calls, log into websites, and even make purchases on the user's behalf.

items.headline: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off
items.excerpt: Google's Gemini update extending chat retention will roll out globally over the coming weeks.

items.headline: As decision model use skyrockets, is customization the next frontier?
items.excerpt: Sqwish Labs has a new wrinkle on the decision model: Train it with your own data to max its capabilities.

items.headline: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
items.excerpt: The company uses agentic AI to make supply chains faster and more reliable.
